note: Korean night 1. Ten vowels + silent ㅇ. Write each ×3, say them out loud. へや ≠ いえ — two minutes, then back to Hangul. The owl hears every ㅡ.

lines.translation: Six you must not mix · 最容易混的六个

tasks.prompt: 1) Write each vowel ㅏㅑㅓㅕㅗㅛㅜㅠㅡㅣ three times while saying it. 2) Read 아야어여오요우유으이 without looking at romanisation. 3) Optional 2 min: say いえ = house, へや = room, then swap them once out loud so you feel the difference.

questions.explain: ㅓ is eo (sounds like “uh”). Arm sits on the LEFT of the vertical line.
ㅡ is eu: just a horizontal bar. Lips stay flat — not round like ㅜ.

questions.q: Silent ㅇ before a vowel means…
options: placeholder so the vowel can stand alone (아, 이, 우…)
questions.explain: ㅇ at the start is a silent placeholder. 아 = a, 이 = i, 우 = u.

questions.q: ㅗ vs ㅜ — which is true?
options: ㅗ stick up = o; ㅜ stick down = u
questions.explain: Stick pointing up from the bar = ㅗ o; stick hanging down = ㅜ u.

questions.q: Write the syllable for vowel ㅏ with silent ㅇ.

questions.explain: いえ ie = house (家). Room is へや heya — yesterday’s mix-up.
へや heya = room (部屋). House is いえ.
